cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit in the good chair. I've put your favourite cup out; you should have the best of this place while you're here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I'll pack the cup for you today. You can keep a little of our Thursdays wherever you go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather leave it here and have another cup next week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave it here, then. I'll keep your chair free, for as many Thursdays as we have left.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs affectionate hospitality; A3 turns the repeated visit into a keepsake; A5 yields to B leaving cup while making the retained chair a finite promise.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 weekly habit informs A3 Thursdays souvenir; B4 asks for next week and A5 retains cup and chair but adds how many left.

relationship.evidence: B4 wants continuing ordinary visits, a concrete alternative to being sent away with a memento.

heightening.evidence: A5 fulfils B4 wish with greater enduring care and more final language than the initial while-you-are-here.

specificity.evidence: A1 cup/chair and B2 Thursdays establish enough relationship history without inventing illness or a move.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 chair-free promise and finite Thursdays carry the emotional double meaning without explaining the card.
